python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
errors = []
for page in Path('docs').rglob('*.md'):
    content = re.sub(r'`[^`\n]+`', '', page.read_text())
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', content):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        filename, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / filename if filename else page
        if not dest.is_file():
            errors.append(f'{page}: missing {target}')
        elif anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            if anchor not in anchors:
                errors.append(f'{page}: missing anchor {target}')
print('\n'.join(errors) if errors else 'All local documentation links and anchors resolve (excluding inline code examples).')
raise SystemExit(bool(errors))
PY
